#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The destination is configured through the DEST environment variable at run
# time (for example in the cron entry), since it is not decided in this repo.
DEST="${DEST:-}"
if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "DEST is not set; set it to a backup destination such as host:/path or /mnt/backups" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
